summary: Creative Quality Engine (Phase 2B mock-only) verified end-to-end. Backend: 102/102 pytest pass (~22s). Curl smoke against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirms exact response shapes for /api/creative/enhancement-hints, POST /projects/{id}/rewrite (now returns quality_scores), POST /projects/{id}/improve-story (returns updated rewritten_story + refreshed quality_scores; pushes improvement_history; 422 on unknown kind), POST /scenes/{id}/enhance-prompt for all 4 kinds (image-prompt, video-prompt, scene-drama, dialogue). Scene tension fields (tension_level, emotional_goal, conflict_point, reveal_or_turning_point, cliffhanger_value, raw_visual_prompt) populated on split. Provider invariant holds: 200/200 rows in /api/admin/provider-activity have mode='mock' and key_present=false. Frontend: All required data-testids render on Story/Scenes/Images/Video Segments tabs; both enhancement banners visible; zero console errors.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Seeded projects 49560a92 and ca07057e initially had quality_scores=None and rewritten_story empty on this preview env — main agent's note said they had been re-rewritten but they were not. Testing agent triggered POST /rewrite + /improve-story on 49560a92 to populate. Re-seed script (or migration on startup) recommended so the seeded projects always demo the new fields.

(Polish, not required by spec) QualityScorePanel uses a single wrapper testid; per-bar testids like data-testid='quality-bar-hook_strength' would make future automation cheaper. Bars render correctly today.
(Polish) SceneTensionMeter rows don't have per-field testids (emotional_goal/conflict_point/etc). Spec asked them to be visible — they are — but per-field testids would help future regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: creative_quality.py is genuinely deterministic (hashlib + seeded random). Same inputs always produce same outputs — re-runs of the e2e tests are stable.

compute_quality_scores uses _clip(lo=20, hi=98) but spec calls for 1-100. In practice outputs land 35-98 because of the base+keyword math, so the 1-100 contract is satisfied. Worth a comment in the module for clarity.
improve-story endpoint correctly $push'es to improvement_history and $set's the new rewritten_story+quality_scores atomically in one update_one call. Good.
GET /projects/{id} response shape is {project, scenes, characters} — not flat. Frontend already handles this; document it for future API consumers.

Provider activity invariant verified across 200 rows: no row leaked mode!='mock' or key_present=true even after improve-story + enhance-prompt traffic. The Creative Quality Engine is fully pure-logic — confirmed by absence of network imports in /app/backend/creative_quality.py.
Carry-over (non-blocking from iter 2/3): DELETE /api/projects/{id} still does not cascade-delete segments whose scenes belong to the project.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required data-testids present on Story/Scenes/Images/Segments; 0 console errors)

seed_data_creation: Triggered POST /api/projects/49560a92.../rewrite and POST /api/projects/49560a92.../improve-story {kind:'suspenseful'} to populate quality_scores + improvement_history on the seeded project (they were empty at start). Triggered enhance-prompt image-prompt/video-prompt/scene-drama/dialogue on scene ac7d38b1 to populate enhanced_image_prompt, enhanced_video_prompt, bumped tension_level, and dialogue. All scenes/projects remain in the same DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest baseline is now 102 tests (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q ~22s). Creative Quality Engine lives at /app/backend/creative_quality.py — pure-logic, deterministic, no network. New endpoints: GET /api/creative/enhancement-hints, POST /api/projects/{id}/quality-score, POST /api/projects/{id}/improve-story, POST /api/scenes/{id}/enhance-prompt. Frontend additions: ImproveStoryMenu (testid improve-story-trigger + improve-story-<kind>), QualityScorePanel (testid quality-score-panel + quality-overall), SceneTensionMeter (tension-meter-<sceneId> + improve-drama-<sceneId> + improve-dialogue-<sceneId>), Enhance buttons + chips on Images/Segments tabs. Video Segments tab testid is 'tab-segments' (NOT 'tab-video-segments'). The wrapper GET /projects/{id} returns {project, scenes, characters} — quality_scores lives on project, not on the top-level dict. Seeded projects need a manual /rewrite call to populate quality_scores in this preview env.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Feature set behaves exactly as specified; the only friction was the seed-state drift on the preview env (quality_scores=None on a seeded project at start) which is a data-seeding gap, not a code bug.
